subject: Vendr onboarding: scope triage + SSO proof & SOC 2 extract
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@brightleaf.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile request + evidence scope

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. BrightLeaf is starting the security intake for the Redwood integration and Vendr sent over a profile request that looks pretty broad — they asked for the full CAIQ + our most recent SOC 2 and a long list of evidence files (logs, KMS diagrams, config screenshots). We want to scope this down where possible to speed review.

Can you confirm:
- whether Redwood can provide a SOC 2 "extract" (control narrative + sub-controls relevant to vendor hosting) instead of the full PDF?
- whether we can upload SAML metadata and a short attestation to Vendr rather than all logs?
- a point of contact at Redwood who can provide the SSO metadata and a snippet that BrightLeaf can attach to the Vendr profile?

Goal is to get BrightLeaf to a green "profile-complete" state in Vendr within 48–72 hours. Appreciate any shortcuts (scoped evidence, presigned links, screenshots).

Thanks,
Lena
Security Program Manager
BrightLeaf

[Attachment: Vendr_profile_request_2026-08-30.json]

From: karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com
To: Lena Park <lena.park@brightleaf.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodai.com, priya_natarajan@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile request + evidence scope

Lena — thanks, forwarding to our security team and ops. Quick proposal to keep the ask minimal and actionable:

1) SOC 2 scope: We can provide a SOC 2 "extract" that contains the control narratives, system description excerpts, and the specific control IDs that map to CAIQ/SIG items BrightLeaf cares about (encryption, access control, logging, incident response). This is redacted to avoid customer PII and internal change logs.

2) Logs & KMS diagrams: instead of raw log dumps, we can provide an architecture diagram and the KMS key scope (which keys are customer-isolated vs platform-managed) + retention policy.

3) SSO & proof: we will supply SAML metadata (or OIDC discovery URL), a short attestation line signed by our security team, and screenshots of the Vendr profile fields pre-populated so you can validate. We'll upload those into the Vendr portal and also share a presigned bundle if they need files offline.

Priya — can you produce the SOC 2 extract + attestation and the saml-metadata XML? Mina — can you grab a clean architecture/KMS diagram and one screenshot of the Vendr upload UI for us to attach? Rafael — FYI on vendor uploads and who to route presigned objects through.

Lena — if that scope is acceptable I can upload the items to the Vendr record and ping you when it's in. If BrightLeaf still requires full CAIQ mapping we can add a CAIQ crosswalk doc but it will add a day.

Next steps:
- Priya: SOC extract + attestation, saml-metadata (today, <24h)
- Mina: architecture diagram + Vendr UI screenshot (today)
- Karthik: upload to Vendr + confirm profile fields (when items arrive)

Thanks —
Karthik
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
